llookup
Description
This command returns a list of values corresponding to the given key.
In case there is no value for thekey or the [mmap] is not a properly
structured multimap, the command will return null. Useful for data
from
ASM::violation details
. This is a safer
shortcut for this tcl code:
This sets $ to the list of values corresponding to a given key $key in
a multimap $m:
set
r
{
}
foreach
pair
[
lsearch
-
inline
-
all
$m
[
concat
$key
*
]
{
lappend
r
[
lindex
$pair
1
]
}
Syntax
llookup
<
mmap
>
<
key
>
